rubric.scope: U01:L01 open source activities and author-created exit check

criteria.expect: Nine identical congruent cubes, one face-connected three-dimensional object without overlaps; drawings or model descriptions physically plausible.
criteria.partial: One demonstrated valid nine-cube model but connection or placement is uncertain.
criteria.reject: Disconnected islands or incorrect cube count.

criteria.expect: Compares cube counts for objects built from same-size cubes, including eight-cube pair equivalence, without deciding from visual height alone.
criteria.partial: Correct comparison without an adequate count/size explanation.

criteria.expect: Shows or precisely describes two distinct face-connected nine-cube solids and explains both have equal volume.
criteria.partial: Two correct arrangements but no explanation.
criteria.reject: A scalar 9 alone or the same shape relabeled.

criteria.expect: Defends a WODB choice or object ordering with geometrical arguments; listens and justifies alternatives, in accessible oral/written/tactile mode.
criteria.partial: Plausible argument missing one required precision.
criteria.reject: One unsupported letter or numeric output.

rubric.acceptance: Teacher assigns 0/1/2 points per criterion; open work is not automatically declared mastered by the numeric practice generator.
